def clean_rects(g, minh=2, minw=2):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[]
    for i0 in range(H):
        for j0 in range(W):
            c=g[i0][j0]
            if c==0: continue
            # max extent down/right keeping full rect solid
            wmax=W-j0
            for i1 in range(i0,H):
                if g[i1][j0]!=c: break
                w=1
                while j0+w<W and g[i1][j0+w]==c and w<wmax: w+=1
                wmax=min(wmax,w) if i1>i0 else w
                # hmm simpler: recompute below
            # brute force: largest solid rect anchored here
            best=(0,0)
            for i1 in range(i0,H):
                row_ok=True; w=0
                while j0+w<W and g[i1][j0+w]==c:
                    w+=1
                if i1==i0: wmax=w
                else: wmax=min(wmax,w)
                if wmax==0: break
                h=i1-i0+1
                if h>=minh and wmax>=minw:
                    # non-extendable check
                    ext_up = i0>0 and all(g[i0-1][j]==c for j in range(j0,j0+wmax))
                    ext_dn = i1<H-1 and all(g[i1+1][j]==c for j in range(j0,j0+wmax))
                    ext_lf = j0>0 and all(g[i][j0-1]==c for i in range(i0,i1+1))
                    ext_rt = j0+wmax<W and all(g[i][j0+wmax]==c for i in range(i0,i1+1))
                    if not (ext_up or ext_dn or ext_lf or ext_rt):
                        res.append((i0,i1,j0,j0+wmax-1,c))
            # dedupe handled by set
    return sorted(set(res))
